definition_en: Electrode of a cell that is at the higher potential; in a lithium-ion cell it holds the lithium metal oxide or phosphate active material on aluminum foil.
ng_note: 「陰極」(JA) は cathode の辞書訳で、日本語の電池分野では負側の電極と受け取られ、リチウムイオン電池の正極と極性が逆に読まれる。韓国語の「음극」は電池業界では負極（anode）を指すため、cathode の訳に使うと正負が逆になる。
source_ref: IEC 60050-482 (International Electrotechnical Vocabulary - Part 482: Primary and secondary cells and batteries); M. Yoshio, R. J. Brodd, A. Kozawa (eds.), Lithium-Ion Batteries: Science and Technologies (Springer, 2009)

definition_en: Cathode material designed to operate at potentials above about 4.3 V vs Li/Li+, such as LNMO or high-voltage LCO, to raise cell energy.
ng_note: 韓国語の「고전압 음극」は cathode を辞書訳の「음극」としたもので、電池業界では負極と読まれ、正極材とは正負が逆になる。
source_ref: A. Manthiram, A reflection on lithium-ion battery cathode chemistry, Nat. Commun. 11 (2020) 1550

definition_en: Cathode layer of an all-solid-state cell in which cathode active material is mixed with solid electrolyte and conductive additive so that ions and electrons can reach every particle.
ng_note: 韓国語の「복합 음극」は cathode を辞書訳の「음극」としたもので、電池業界では複合負極と読まれ、正負が逆になる。
source_ref: Schnell et al., All-solid-state lithium-ion and lithium metal batteries — paving the way to large-scale production, J. Power Sources 382, 160–175 (2018)

definition_en: Test cell with a reference electrode in addition to the positive and negative electrodes, so that the potential of each electrode can be measured separately during cycling or impedance tests.
source_ref: Korthauer (ed.), Lithium-Ion Batteries: Basics and Applications, Springer (2018)

definition_en: Raw material designated by the EU as economically important and at high supply risk, a list that includes lithium, cobalt, natural graphite and battery-grade nickel, triggering sourcing, stockpiling and recycling measures.
source_ref: Regulation (EU) 2024/1252 (Critical Raw Materials Act)

definition_en: Method that forces mercury into a porous sample at increasing pressure and converts the intruded volume into a pore size distribution and porosity, applied to electrodes, separators and powders.
source_ref: ISO 15901-1 (Pore size distribution and porosity of solid materials by mercury porosimetry and gas adsorption - Part 1: Mercury porosimetry); ISO 15901-1 Pore size distribution and porosity of solid materials by mercury porosimetry and gas adsorption - Part 1: Mercury porosimetry

definition_en: Cyclic ester (lactone) solvent with high permittivity, a high boiling point and a low melting point, used in some lithium-ion and lithium primary electrolytes.
variants_ja: ガンマブチロラクトン
source_ref: K. Xu, Nonaqueous liquid electrolytes for lithium-based rechargeable batteries, Chem. Rev. 104 (2004) 4303

definition_en: Polymer in the electrode coating that binds active and conductive particles to each other and to the current collector foil, such as PVDF for cathodes or SBR/CMC for anodes.
variants_ja: バインダ;結着剤;結着材
ng_note: 中国語「活页夹」、ドイツ語「Ordner」、スペイン語「carpeta」は書類を綴じるバインダー（ファイル）の意味で、電極の結着剤には使わない。
source_ref: H. Chen et al., Exploring chemical, mechanical, and electrical functionalities of binders for advanced energy-storage devices, Chem. Rev. 118 (2018) 8936

definition_en: Metal foil, normally copper, that carries the negative active material layer and conducts current to the negative tab.
ng_note: 日本語の「陽極集電体」は anode を電気分解の陽極（プラス側）と字面訳したもので、電池では anode は負極と訳す。韓国語「양극」は電池では正極を意味するため、「양극 집전체」は正極集電体になる。
source_ref: Furukawa Electric: electrodeposited copper foil for lithium-ion batteries public page

definition_en: Electrode slurry for the negative electrode, typically graphite, sometimes blended with silicon, with conductive additive and CMC/SBR binders dispersed in water.
ng_note: 日本語「陽極スラリー」は anode を電気分解などの陽極と字面どおりに訳したもので、日本語の電池分野では正極側と読まれる。韓国語「양극 슬러리」は電池では正極スラリーを意味し、負極とは正負が逆になる。
source_ref: PEM RWTH Aachen & VDMA Battery Production, Production of Lithium-Ion Battery Cell Components (brochure)

definition_en: Loading of the raw materials for a slurry batch, powders and liquids, into the mixer in the specified amounts and order.
ng_note: 「充電」（中国語「充电」）は電池に電気を充電する意味で、ミキサーへ原料を入れる操作には使わない。
source_ref: PEM RWTH Aachen & VDMA Battery Production, Production of Lithium-Ion Battery Cell Components (brochure)

definition_en: Gradual change in the pH of an aqueous electrode slurry during storage, for example a rise caused by lithium leaching from nickel-rich cathode particles.
source_ref: Hawley & Li, Electrode manufacturing for lithium-ion batteries, J. Energy Storage 25 (2019)

definition_en: Technique used to apply the electrode slurry or another liquid layer onto the substrate, such as slot-die, comma, gravure or roll coating.
source_ref: Cohen & Gutoff, Modern Coating and Drying Technology, Wiley-VCH (1992)

definition_en: Enclosed, usually multi-zone section of an electrode coating line in which heated air removes the solvent from the wet coating as the web passes through.
ng_note: 「ドライルーム」（日本語）・「干燥房」（中国語）・「드라이룸」（韓国語）・「Trockenraum」（ドイツ語）・「sala seca」（スペイン語）は低露点に保つ作業室（dry room）で、塗工機の乾燥炉とは別の設備。
source_ref: Duerr, battery electrode coating and drying systems (public product page); Cohen & Gutoff, Modern Coating and Drying Technology, Wiley-VCH (1992)

definition_en: Electrode coating layer left on the foil after the solvent has been removed in the dryer, before calendering.
ng_note: 日本語の「ドライフィルム」はプリント基板製造に使う感光性のドライフィルムレジストを指す語で、乾燥後の電極塗膜には使わない。
source_ref: ISO 2808 Paints and varnishes - Determination of film thickness

definition_en: Machine with two or more heated, precision-ground rolls that compacts the dried electrode coating to the target thickness and density as the web runs through the nip.
ng_note: スペイン語の「satinadora」は紙・布の表面につやを出す仕上げ用カレンダーを指し、電極を圧密するロールプレス機には使わない。
source_ref: PEM RWTH Aachen / VDMA: Production process of a lithium-ion battery cell (public process guide); Matthews International (Saueressig): battery electrode calender (public product page)

definition_en: Manually initiated function that brings a production machine, such as a winder, stacker or formation line, to a stop as quickly as is safe in order to avert or limit danger.
ng_note: 「desconexión de emergencia」（スペイン語）は電源を断つ非常遮断（emergency switching off）の語で、機械の動きを止める非常停止とは別概念。
source_ref: IEC 60204-1 Safety of machinery - Electrical equipment of machines - Part 1: General requirements; ISO 13850 Safety of machinery - Emergency stop function - Principles for design

definition_en: Machine that unwinds the electrode parent roll, slits it lengthwise with knives or laser and rewinds the strips onto separate cores.
source_ref: PEM RWTH Aachen / VDMA: Production process of a lithium-ion battery cell (public process guide); Kampf Schneid- und Wickeltechnik: slitter rewinders for battery electrodes (public product pages)

definition_en: Lower, female cutting tool of a punching or notching die whose opening, together with the punch, shears the electrode.
ng_note: 「芯片」（中国語）は半導体のダイ（チップ）で、プレス金型のダイではない。
source_ref: Schuler GmbH, Metal Forming Handbook, Springer (1998)

definition_en: Machine that stacks cut cathode and anode sheets with separator into an electrode stack, by single-sheet, Z-folding or lamination methods.
ng_note: 中国語の「堆垛机」は倉庫でパレットや荷を積み上げる搬送設備（スタッカークレーン）を指し、電極シートを積層する積層機ではない。
source_ref: PEM RWTH Aachen / VDMA: Production process of a lithium-ion battery cell (public process guide); Manz AG: battery cell assembly - notching, cutting, stacking, lamination (public product pages)

definition_en: Groove melted into the base metal along the toe of a weld and left unfilled, which reduces the cross-section and acts as a notch, for example in laser welds of busbars or can lids.
ng_note: ドイツ語の「Hinterschneidung」は機械加工品や成形品のアンダーカット（えぐれ形状）を指し、溶接止端に残る溶接欠陥のアンダーカットは「Einbrandkerbe」。
source_ref: ISO 6520-1 Welding and allied processes - Classification of geometric imperfections in metallic materials - Part 1: Fusion welding

definition_en: Droplets of molten metal thrown out of the weld pool during laser or resistance welding; in cell assembly they are conductive particles that can cause internal short circuits.
ng_note: 「スパッタリング」（日本語）・「溅射」（中国語）・「스퍼터링」（韓国語）は薄膜を成膜するスパッタリング（sputtering）を指す別概念で、溶接時に飛散する溶融金属の粒には使わない。
source_ref: ISO 6520-1 Classification of geometric imperfections in metallic materials - Part 1: Fusion welding; ISO 6520-1 Welding and allied processes - Classification of geometric imperfections in metallic materials - Part 1: Fusion welding

definition_en: Lens-shaped zone of metal that melted and solidified at the interface between the parts in a resistance spot weld; its diameter is the main measure of joint strength.
source_ref: AWS A3.0M/A3.0 Standard Welding Terms and Definitions

definition_en: Geometric type of a cell defined by its housing and electrode arrangement, mainly cylindrical, prismatic or pouch, which determines assembly processes and pack design.
ng_note: 日本語の「セルの書式」、中国語の「单元格格式」、韓国語の「셀 서식」は表計算ソフトのセルの書式を指す語で、電池セルの形状の区分には使わない。
source_ref: PEM RWTH Aachen & VDMA Battery Production, Production Process of a Lithium-Ion Battery Cell (brochure)

definition_en: Cell housed in a rigid rectangular metal or plastic case, usually containing a flat-wound or stacked electrode assembly.
variants_ja: 角形電池;角型セル;角型電池
source_ref: IEC 61960-3 Secondary lithium cells and batteries for portable applications - Part 3: Prismatic and cylindrical lithium secondary cells and batteries made from them

definition_en: Electrically conductive part of a cell or battery to which external conductors are connected for charging and discharging.
ng_note: 「端末」（日本語）・「终端」（中国語）・「단말기」（韓国語）は情報機器の端末（computer terminal）の語で、電池の端子には使わない。
source_ref: IEC 60050-482 International Electrotechnical Vocabulary - Part 482: Primary and secondary cells and batteries

definition_en: Letting gas into an evacuated chamber to bring it back to atmospheric pressure at the end of a filling or drying cycle.
ng_note: 「換気」（日本語）・「通风」（中国語）・「환기」（韓国語）は室内などの空気の入れ換えを指し、真空チャンバーにガスを入れて大気圧に戻す操作には使わない。
source_ref: Pfeiffer Vacuum, The Vacuum Technology Book

definition_en: Hole, crack, porous path or seal defect through which gas or liquid can pass from one side of a cell or housing wall to the other.
ng_note: 「漏液」（中国語「漏液」、韓国語「누액」）は電解液が外へ漏れ出す現象で、気体も通る穴・経路としてのリーク（漏孔）とは別概念。
source_ref: ISO 20484 Non-destructive testing - Leak testing - Vocabulary

definition_en: Closed, usually stainless-steel tank kept under a dry nitrogen or argon blanket that holds electrolyte at the filling line and feeds the dosing pumps.
source_ref: Wuxi Lead Intelligent Equipment, cell assembly and electrolyte filling equipment, public product pages

definition_en: Breakdown of electrolyte solvents and salt by reduction at the negative electrode surface at low potential, the reaction that builds the SEI.
source_ref: Xu, Nonaqueous liquid electrolytes for lithium-based rechargeable batteries, Chem. Rev. 104 (2004)

definition_en: Duration for which filled or formed cells are stored at a set temperature in the aging step, typically days to weeks, before OCV is measured again.
ng_note: 日本語「劣化時間」・韓国語「노화 시간」は劣化が進む時間の意味になり、化成後のセルを所定温度で静置するエージング工程の時間を表さない。
source_ref: Wood, Li & Daniel, Formation Challenges of Lithium-Ion Battery Manufacturing, Joule 3 (2019)

definition_en: Physical separation of finished cells into bins or trays by grade, based on measured capacity, OCV, internal resistance and self-discharge.
ng_note: 中国語「排序」・韓国語「정렬」はデータを順に並べ替える意味の sorting の訳で、セルを等級ごとに物理的に仕分ける選別には使わない。
source_ref: Wood, Li & Daniel, Formation Challenges of Lithium-Ion Battery Manufacturing, Joule 3 (2019); Wuxi Lead Intelligent Equipment, public formation & grading / logistics equipment pages

definition_en: Capacity of a cell or battery declared by the manufacturer for a specified discharge rate, temperature and end-of-discharge voltage.
ng_note: 日本語「公称容量」は電池を識別するための概略の容量値（nominal capacity）で、メーカーが規定条件で宣言する定格容量とは別概念。
source_ref: IEC 60050-482 International Electrotechnical Vocabulary — Part 482: Primary and secondary cells and batteries

definition_en: Operation in which a cell or battery delivers electric current to an external circuit, converting stored chemical energy into electrical energy.
ng_note: 「排出」（日本語）・「排放」（中国語）・「배출」（韓国語）・「Austrag」（ドイツ語）は液体・粉体などを外へ出すことで、電池から電流を取り出す放電とは別概念。
source_ref: IEC 60050-482 International Electrotechnical Vocabulary — Part 482: Primary and secondary cells and batteries

definition_en: Realization of a defined quantity value with a stated measurement uncertainty, such as a standard resistor, reference voltage source or reference thermometer, used as the reference when calibrating cell test equipment.
ng_note: 「測定規格」(JA)・「norma de medición」(ES)は文書としての規格の意味になり、校正の基準器・基準値を指す本語とは別概念。
source_ref: JCGM 200 International vocabulary of metrology — Basic and general concepts and associated terms (VIM)

definition_en: Chemical hardening of an adhesive, potting compound or sealant by reaction, heat, moisture or UV until it reaches its specified strength.
ng_note: 「curación」（ES）は傷病の治癒の意味で、接着剤・樹脂の硬化には「curado」を使う。
source_ref: Henkel: battery assembly adhesives, thermal interface materials and coatings (technical pages)

definition_en: Metered application of a fluid material, such as adhesive, sealant or thermal interface material, through a nozzle in a programmed bead or dot pattern.
ng_note: 「調剤」(JA)・「配药」(ZH)は薬の調剤の意味で、接着剤・TIMの定量吐出には使わない。
source_ref: Atlas Copco: battery assembly joining, tightening and dispensing solutions (application pages)

definition_en: Integral of the square of the current over the duration of a fault current, stated for a fuse as pre-arcing and operating I²t and used to coordinate battery fuses with busbars, contactors and cells.
source_ref: IEC 60269 Low-voltage fuses (series)

definition_en: Integrated circuit in a BMS that measures the voltages of a series string of cells, and often temperatures, with high accuracy, provides balancing switches and passes the data to the controller.
term_ja: アナログフロントエンド
source_ref: Texas Instruments: battery management ICs product pages and application notes

definition_en: Part of a conductive EV charging coupler attached to the flexible charging cable, which mates with the vehicle inlet.
ng_note: 「车辆插座」は中国語（GB/T 20234）で vehicle inlet（車両側の受け口）を指す別概念。「Fahrzeugstecker」はドイツ語（DIN EN 62196）で vehicle inlet の正式表記で、vehicle connector に使うと逆になる。
source_ref: IEC 62196 Plugs, socket-outlets, vehicle connectors and vehicle inlets – Conductive charging of electric vehicles (series)

definition_en: Part of a conductive EV charging coupler built into the vehicle, into which the vehicle connector is inserted.
ng_note: 「车辆插头」は中国語（GB/T 20234）で vehicle connector（ケーブル側）を指す別概念。「Fahrzeugkupplung」はドイツ語（DIN EN 62196）で vehicle connector の正式表記で、vehicle inlet には使わない。
source_ref: IEC 62196 Plugs, socket-outlets, vehicle connectors and vehicle inlets – Conductive charging of electric vehicles (series)

definition_en: Compressive load applied by the crush plate to a cell, module or pack in a crush test, used as one of the limits at which the plate is stopped.
ng_note: 「破砕力」（日本語）の破砕は電池リサイクルなどで材料を細かく砕く処理の語で、圧壊試験で押し板がセルに加える荷重には使わない。
source_ref: GB 38031-2020 Electric vehicles traction battery safety requirements

definition_en: Cell or battery voltage above the upper limit set by the manufacturer, usually caused by overcharge or a charger fault.
ng_note: 中国語の「过电位」は電極反応の過電位（overpotential）を指す電気化学の用語で、電圧が上限を超える過電圧には「过电压」を使う。
source_ref: Reddy T.B. (ed.), Linden's Handbook of Batteries, 4th ed., McGraw-Hill (2011)

definition_en: Gas CO2 that forms a major part of the vent gas of lithium-ion cells in thermal runaway, produced by oxidation and decomposition of carbonate electrolyte.
source_ref: UL 9540A Test Method for Evaluating Thermal Runaway Fire Propagation in Battery Energy Storage Systems

definition_en: Feature in an X-ray or CT image that does not exist in the object, such as streaks from metal parts, beam hardening or ring artifacts, which can be mistaken for defects.
ng_note: 中国語の「人工制品」は artifact を人工物の意味で訳した辞書訳で、X線・CT画像の偽像には「伪影」を使う。
source_ref: ISO 15708-1 Non-destructive testing - Radiation methods for computed tomography - Part 1: Terminology

definition_en: Physical, chemical or other process that leads to a failure, such as lithium plating, SEI growth, gas generation or weld fatigue in a cell or battery.
source_ref: IEC 60050-192:2015 International Electrotechnical Vocabulary - Part 192: Dependability

definition_en: Central unit housing fans, coils, filters and dampers that conditions and moves air for rooms; for dry rooms combined with a desiccant dehumidifier.
term_ja: エアハンドリングユニット
source_ref: ASHRAE Handbook — HVAC Applications (chapter: Clean Spaces)

definition_en: Central computer system that monitors and controls building services such as HVAC, dehumidifiers, lighting and alarms across a plant.
variants_ja: ビルマネジメントシステム;ビルディングオートメーションシステム
ng_ja: バッテリーマネジメントシステム;電池管理システム
ng_note: 略語 BMS が電池管理システム（battery management system）と同じため、「バッテリーマネジメントシステム」「電池管理システム」（日本語）・「电池管理系统」（中国語）・「배터리 관리 시스템」（韓国語）・「Batteriemanagementsystem」（ドイツ語）・「sistema de gestión de baterías」（スペイン語）と展開すると別概念になる。建物設備の BMS は建物管理システム。
source_ref: ASHRAE Handbook — HVAC Applications (chapter: Clean Spaces)

definition_en: All active fire protection installed in a facility, covering detection, alarm and suppression.
ng_note: 「防火設備」（日本語）は建築基準法上の防火戸・防火シャッター等の語で、検知・警報・消火を含む消防設備全体には使わない。
source_ref: NFPA 25 (Standard for the Inspection, Testing, and Maintenance of Water-Based Fire Protection Systems)

definition_en: Recovery of a metal such as cobalt, nickel or copper by electrolysis of a purified solution, depositing the metal on the cathode with insoluble anodes.
ng_note: 「電解精製」（日本語）・「电解精炼」（中国語）・「전해정련」（韓国語）・「Raffinationselektrolyse」（ドイツ語）・「electrorrefinación」（スペイン語）は、粗金属の陽極を溶かして純度を上げる電解精製（electrorefining）を指す別の工程で、溶液から金属を電解析出させる電解採取には使わない。
source_ref: F. Habashi (ed.), Handbook of Extractive Metallurgy (Wiley-VCH, 1997)
